title: Multi-Agent Systems
overview: Study settings where several agents interact, cooperating, competing, or negotiating.
objectives: Differentiate cooperative, competitive, and mixed settings
Use Nash equilibrium on a simple game
Describe coordination patterns for LLM-based agent teams

method.title: Interaction types
method.body: Agents may share goals, have opposing goals, or a mix, which changes how they should reason about each other.

method.title: Game theory
method.body: A Nash equilibrium is a joint strategy where no agent gains by changing only its own choice.

method.title: Coordination
method.body: Communication protocols, role assignment, and auctions distribute work among agents.

method.title: Challenges
method.body: Non-stationary environments, credit assignment, and emergent behaviors make multi-agent learning difficult.

quiz.question: A Nash equilibrium means:
options: No agent benefits from a unilateral change
